units.source_text: 且说京中自从源氏公子去后，经过若干日月，自朱雀帝以下，许多人都挂念他。

en.t: Now, in the capital, after Prince Genji had gone away, many days and months passed, and everyone from Emperor Suzaku downward worried about him.

units.source_text: 尤其是皇太子，常常想念他，偷偷地哭泣。

en.t: The Crown Prince in particular often thought of him and wept in secret.

units.source_text: 他的乳母看了很可怜他。

en.t: When his nurse saw this, she pitied him deeply.

units.source_text: 详悉底蕴的王命妇看了更加伤心。

en.t: Lady Omyobu, who knew the full truth of the matter, was even more heartbroken when she saw it.

units.source_text: 师姑藤壶皇后一向担心皇太子的前程，

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo, now a nun, had always worried about the Crown Prince's future,

units.source_text: 源氏公子放逐以后，更加忧惧，终日愁叹。

en.t: and after Prince Genji was banished, her fear grew still stronger, and she spent every day grieving and sighing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子兄弟辈的诸皇子，以及向来与公子亲善的诸公卿，

en.t: The princes who were Prince Genji's brothers, together with the nobles who had long been close to him,

units.source_text: 起初常有书信寄须磨慰问，并且有富于情味的诗文互相赠答。

en.t: at first often sent letters of comfort to Suma, and exchanged poems and writings rich in feeling with him.

units.source_text: 但因源氏公子以诗文著名于世，弘徽殿太后听到他们同他唱和，很不高兴，骂道：

en.t: But because Prince Genji was famous throughout the world for his poetry and prose, the Kokiden Empress Dowager was very displeased when she heard that they were answering him in verse, and she rebuked them, saying:

units.source_text: “获罪于朝廷的人，不得任意行动，连饮食之事也不得自由。

en.t: "A man who has offended the court may not act as he pleases; even matters of food and drink are not left to his own freedom.

units.source_text: 现在这个源氏在流放地造起风雅的邸宅来，又作诗文诽谤朝政，

en.t: Now this Genji has built an elegant residence in his place of exile, and writes poems and prose slandering the government,

units.source_text: 居然也有人附和他，像跟着赵高指鹿为马一样。”

en.t: and yet there are actually people who echo him, just like those who followed Zhao Gao in calling a deer a horse."
So all sorts of malicious rumors spread through society.

units.source_text: 诸皇子等听到了，害怕起来，此后就不再有人敢和源氏公子通音信了。

en.t: When the princes and others heard this, they became frightened, and after that no one dared to exchange messages with Prince Genji anymore.
